issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 1,228.45 (line 6 property taxes blank in columns 1 and 2)
issues.issue: This is 100% of receipts. It equals the column 3 property tax figure exactly (1,228.45), so it is probably the district's tax/assessment receipts entered on the wrong line. 'other' with review is defensible, but a person may want to recategorize it as property tax.
decision_needed[] is missing. Only a person can settle whether the line that is the district's entire receipts (equal to the budgeted property tax) should be treated as property tax.
